name: tr_tjd
caption:
IF TRAYCE JACKSON-DAVIS HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🛡️ Bastiodon: repels any attack from the front. Indiana's all-time leader in blocks (270) and rebounds (1,143)
🔥 Magmortar: blasts fireballs from its arms. 43 points vs Marshall, Indiana's first 40-point game in 27 years
💪 Machamp: four arms, a master of every martial art. Karl Malone Award, the nation's top power forward
🪙 Gholdengo: a body made of stacked coins. Pick 57, Washington sold his rights for cash
⚡ Electivire: its voltage jumps in battle. 10 points and 10 rebounds in 15 minutes in his debut for us, 5th ever in our history
🦏 Rhyperior: fires rocks from its palms. 71.4% shooting through 8 games

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Trayce Jackson-Davis had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF TJD HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Bastiodon. Any attack from the front just bounces off it. Trayce left Indiana as its all-time leader in blocks and rebounds.
beats.dlg: REPELS ANY FRONT ATTACK.|INDIANA'S ALL-TIME BLOCKS

beats.vo: Magmortar. It blasts fireballs out of its arms. Forty-three points against Marshall, Indiana's first forty-point game in twenty-seven years.
beats.dlg: IT BLASTS FIREBALLS.|43 PTS, 1ST 40 IN 27 YRS

beats.vo: Machamp. Four arms, and it's said to have mastered every martial art. He won the Karl Malone Award, for the best power forward in the country.
beats.dlg: MASTERED EVERY MARTIAL ART|KARL MALONE AWARD!

beats.vo: Gholdengo. Its whole body is made of stacked coins. Fitting: he went fifty-seventh, and Washington sold his rights for cash.
beats.dlg: A BODY MADE OF COINS.|PICK 57, SOLD FOR CASH!

beats.vo: Electivire. Its voltage jumps whenever it's battling. His debut for us: ten points, ten rebounds in fifteen minutes. Only the fifth in our history.
beats.dlg: VOLTAGE JUMPS IN BATTLE.|DEBUT: 10 PTS, 10 REB!

beats.vo: And the ace. Rhyperior. It fires rocks out of the holes in its palms. Trayce is shooting seventy-one point four percent through eight games.
beats.dlg: FIRES ROCKS FROM ITS PALMS|71.4% FG, FIRST 8 GAMES

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Finished his Indiana career as the program's all-time leader in rebounds (1,143) and blocked shots (270); November 27, 2021: career-high 43 points vs Marshall, first (1st) Indiana player to score at least 40 points in 27 years; awarded the Karl Malone Award for the nation's top power forward; drafted 57th overall (#57) in 2023, the pick held by Washington, who traded his rights for cash considerations; Raptors debut: 10 points and 10 rebounds in 15 minutes, fifth (5th) player in franchise history with a double-double in their debut
